unit: python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv" && "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --require-hashes -r requirements-dev.lock && "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" -m coverage run -m pytest -q && "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" -m coverage xml
regression: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ripgrep jq && python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv" && "$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --require-hashes -r requirements-dev.lock && PYTHON_BIN="$RUNNER_TEMP/venv/bin/python" bash tests/run-all.sh
e2e: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ripgrep jq && for suite in scripts/test-memory-*.sh; do echo "== $suite"; bash "$suite" || exit 1; done
environment: mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude" && bash scripts/setup.sh install --dry-run && bash tools/plugin-version-check.sh --json
install: claude plugin marketplace add "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE:-$PWD}" && claude plugin install zetetic-team-subagents@zetetic-marketplace && claude plugin list && claude --init-only
